text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Next, let's organize support cards that will 
help you train your horsegirl!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Each card has its own effects, such as the 
appearance of the characters in the support 
card during training or giving you skills!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Please keep in mind you can't use 
support cards of the same horsegirl 
that you're training!
color_text_info_list: of the same Umamusume being trained
Support Cards cannot be included in the deck
